'''Cătălina Oana Curceanu'''<ref name=":0"/> is a Romanian physicist and lead researcher at the [[Istituto Nazionale di Fisica Nucleare]]. She researches low energy [[quantum chromodynamics]].

== Early life and education ==
Curceanu was born in [[Transylvania]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://physics.anu.edu.au/events/?EventID=498|title=Event - Catalina Curceanu - The Standard Model of elementary particle physics: how well do we understand the Universe? - RSPE - ANU|last1=RSPE|first1=Director|last2=director@physics.anu.edu.au|website=physics.anu.edu.au|language=en|access-date=2018-08-09}}</ref> She became interested in science as a child, and applied to the ''Mathematics and Physics Lyceum at Magurele'' in Bucharest.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=http://www.rgnpress.ro/rgn_14/categorii/analize-interviuri/18103-interviu-cu-dr-ctlina-oana-curceanu--organizator-al-celui-de-al-xxxix-lea-congres-al-academiei-romano-americane.html|title=Interviu cu dr. Cătălina Oana Curceanu – organizator al celui de al XXXIX-lea Congres al Academiei Româno-Americane {{!}} Analize / Interviuri|last=Global News|first=Romanian|website=www.rgnpress.ro|language=ro-ro|access-date=2018-08-09|archive-date=2018-08-10|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180810042008/http://www.rgnpress.ro/rgn_14/categorii/analize-interviuri/18103-interviu-cu-dr-ctlina-oana-curceanu--organizator-al-celui-de-al-xxxix-lea-congres-al-academiei-romano-americane.html}}</ref> She attributes her passion for physics to her very skilled teachers.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cariereonline.ro/leadership/work-life-choices/catalina-oana-curceanu-in-cercetare-nu-exista-orar-de-lucru-ci-doar|title=Cătălina Oana Curceanu - "În cercetare nu există orar de lucru, ci doar bucuria descoperirii"|last=Teodorescu|first=Daniela Palade|website=www.cariereonline.ro|language=ro|access-date=2018-08-09|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180810010945/https://www.cariereonline.ro/leadership/work-life-choices/catalina-oana-curceanu-in-cercetare-nu-exista-orar-de-lucru-ci-doar|archive-date=2018-08-10}}</ref> She studied physics at the [[University of Bucharest]] and graduated as a [[Valedictorian]].<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=http://www.romaniaincontact.com/en/2014/05/20/catalina-curceanu/|title=Space time travel through the fascinating world of nuclear particles alongside the researcher Cătălina Curceanu {{!}} Romania in Contact|website=www.romaniaincontact.com|language=en-US|access-date=2018-08-09|archive-date=2018-08-10|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180810011414/http://www.romaniaincontact.com/en/2014/05/20/catalina-curceanu/}}</ref> She carried out her doctoral research using the [[Low Energy Antiproton Ring]] at [[CERN]] on the OBELIX experiment.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.lnf.infn.it/edu/incontri/relatori/curceanu1.html|title=LNF/IDF|website=www.lnf.infn.it|access-date=2018-08-09}}{{Dead link|date=January 2026 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref> She earned her PhD from the [[Horia Hulubei National Institute of Physics and Nuclear Engineering]].<ref name=":3">{{Cite web|url=http://www.cambridgescholars.com/t/AdvisoryBoardCatalina|title=Cambridge Scholars Publishing|website=www.cambridgescholars.com|access-date=2018-08-09|archive-date=2018-08-10|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180810011305/http://www.cambridgescholars.com/t/AdvisoryBoardCatalina}}</ref>

== Research and career ==
In 1992 Curceanu joined the [[Istituto Nazionale di Fisica Nucleare]].<ref name=":0" /> She uses the [[DAFNE]] (DAΦNE) collider at [[Frascati]].<ref name=":0" /> She is part of the [[VIP2 experiment]] (Violation of the Pauli Principle) in the [[Laboratori Nazionali del Gran Sasso]].<ref>{{cite arXiv|last1=Marton|first1=Johann|last2=Bartalucci|first2=S.|last3=Bassi|first3=A.|last4=Bazzi|first4=M.|last5=Bertolucci|first5=S.|last6=Berucci|first6=C.|last7=Bragadireanu|first7=M.|last8=Cargnelli|first8=M.|last9=Clozza|first9=A.|date=2017-03-29|title=Underground test of quantum mechanics - the VIP2 experiment|eprint=1703.10055|class=quant-ph}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Pichler|first1=A.|last2=Bartalucci|first2=S.|last3=Bazzi|first3=M.|last4=Bertolucci|first4=S.|last5=Berucci|first5=C.|last6=Bragadireanu|first6=M.|last7=Cargnelli|first7=M.|last8=Clozza|first8=A.|last9=Curceanu|first9=C.|date=2016-06-09|title=Application of photon detectors in the VIP2 experiment to test the Pauli Exclusion Principle|url=http://inspirehep.net/record/1419112/citations|journal=J. Phys. Conf. Ser.|volume=718|issue=5|article-number=052030|doi=10.1088/1742-6596/718/5/052030|arxiv=1602.00898|bibcode=2016JPhCS.718e2030P|s2cid=119191907}}</ref> In 2010 she was awarded Personality of the Year by the [[Romanian Academy in Rome]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://accentmontreal.com/un-nou-premiu-prestigios-pentru-cercetatoarea-catalina-curceanu/|title=Un nou premiu prestigios pentru cercetătoarea Cătălina Curceanu {{!}} Accent Montreal|website=accentmontreal.com|date=7 April 2017 |language=ro-RO|access-date=2018-08-09}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=http://financiarul.ro/2010/11/02/romanians-and-italians-rewarded-at-celebrity-gala-awards-in-rome/|title=Romanians and Italians rewarded at Celebrity Gala Awards in Rome - Financiarul.ro|date=2010-11-02|work=Financiarul.ro|access-date=2018-08-09|language=ro-RO|archive-date=2018-08-10|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180810011500/http://financiarul.ro/2010/11/02/romanians-and-italians-rewarded-at-celebrity-gala-awards-in-rome/}}</ref> She works at [[CERN]] on the OBELIX experiment, looking for [[Exotic meson]]s, and DIRAC, looking for exotic pionium.<ref name=":1" />
[[File:Intervista di Alessandra de Vitis (WikiDonne) a Cătălina Curceanu.ogg|thumb|right|300px|Interview by Alessandra de Vitis (WikiDonne) with the researcher of the National Institute of Nuclear Physics in Frascati, Cătălina Curceanu (in Italian)]]
She published the popular science book ''Dai Buchi Neri all'adroterapia. Un Viaggio nella Fisica Moderna'' in 2013 with [[Springer Publishing|Springer]].<ref name=":4">{{Cite book|url=https://www.springer.com/us/book/9788847052406|title=Dai buchi neri all'adroterapia - Un viaggio nella Fisica Moderna {{!}} Catalina Oana Curceanu {{!}} Springer|language=en|isbn=978-88-470-5240-6|publisher=Springer|year=2013|series=I blu}}</ref> The book considers concepts of modern physics, including; the [[Standard Model|standard model]], [[black hole]]s and [[neutrino]]s.<ref name=":4" /> In 2015 she was awarded a $85,000 grant from [[Foundational Questions Institute|FQXI]] and the [[John Templeton Foundation]]s for her quantum physics research.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.researchitaly.it/en/news/infn-catalina-curceanu-awarded-by-templeton-foundation/|title=INFN: Catalina Curceanu awarded by Templeton Foundation|work=ResearchItaly - INFN: Catalina Curceanu awarded by Templeton Foundation|access-date=2018-08-09|language=en-US|archive-date=2018-08-10|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180810042026/https://www.researchitaly.it/en/news/infn-catalina-curceanu-awarded-by-templeton-foundation/}}</ref> Her proposal considered collapse models and the measurement problem.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://fqxi.org/grants/large/awardees/view/__details/2015/curceanu|title=FQXi - Foundational Questions Institute|website=fqxi.org|language=en-US|access-date=2018-08-09}}</ref> She used an ultrapure [[Germanium Detector Array|germanium detector]] to test the radiation it emits.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://fqxi.org/community/articles/display/212|title=Collapsing Physics: Q&A with Catalina Oana Curceanu|website=fqxi.org|date=24 May 2016 |language=en-US|access-date=2018-08-09}}</ref> Her recent work involves the SIDDHARTA experiment, looking at the [[strong interaction]] and [[strangeness]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ansto.gov.au/news/two-lectures-from-distinguished-physicist-exploring-strange-and-impossible-phenomena|title=Two lectures from distinguished physicist exploring strange and impossible phenomena {{!}} ANSTO|website=www.ansto.gov.au|language=en|access-date=2018-08-09}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www0.mi.infn.it/~crespi/ita_giap_pdf/curceanu.pdf|title=DEAR and SIDDHARTA collaborations|last=Curceanu|first=Catalina|date=2012-11-22|website=Milan|access-date=2018-08-09}}</ref>

Curceanu was the [[Australian Institute of Physics]] Women in Physics lecturer in 2016.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.epsnews.eu/2016/05/fearless-physics-catalina-curceanu-wip-lecturer/|title=Fearless physics: Catalina Curceanu, WIP Lecturer {{!}} e-EPS|website=www.epsnews.eu|language=en-US|access-date=2018-08-09}}</ref> In her lectures she asked "''Quo Vadis the Universe'''".<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://womeninphysicsoz.blogspot.com/2016/06/be-curious-introducing-prof-catalina_28.html|title=Women In Physics - Australia: Be curious! Introducing Prof Catalina Curceanu our 2016 Women in Physics Lecture|last=Helen|date=2016-06-28|website=Women In Physics - Australia|access-date=2018-08-09}}</ref> She has spoken about [[quantum computers]] at [[TED (conference)|TED]]<nowiki/>x [[Brașov]] and [[TED (conference)|TED]]<nowiki/>x [[Cluj-Napoca]].<ref>{{Citation|last=TEDx Talks|title=How Quantum Computers Work? {{!}} Catalina Curceanu {{!}} TEDxBrașov|date=2017-12-01|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OhmdaXnueh0|access-date=2018-08-09}}</ref><ref>{{Citation|last=TEDx Talks|title=How quantum computers work {{!}} Cătălina Curceanu {{!}} TEDxCluj|date=2018-06-27|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3xHVcKeuF5o|access-date=2018-08-09}}</ref> She won the 2017 [[European Physical Society]] ''[[Emmy Noether]] Distinction for Women in Physics'' for her contributions to low-energy QCD.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://w3.lnf.infn.it/eps-prize-for-physics-emmy-noether-goes-to-catalina-curceanu/?lang=en|title=EPS PRIZE FOR PHYSICS "EMMY NOETHER" GOES TO CATALINA CURCEANU {{!}} INFN-LNF|website=w3.lnf.infn.it|date=21 June 2017 |language=en-US|access-date=2018-08-09}}</ref> She won a Visiting International Scholar Award from the [[University of Wollongong]] in 2017, researching detector systems for high precision spectroscopy in fundamental physics.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.uow.edu.au/research/researchgrants/visaprogram/UOW190234.html|title=Recipients|website=www.uow.edu.au|language=en-au|others=amorgan|access-date=2018-08-09}}</ref> She is involved with several outreach and education activities.<ref name=":2" /><ref name=":3" />
